import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import './AccountPage.css'; const AccountPage = () => { const [showChat, setShowChat] = useState(false); const [driverName, setDriverName] = useState('Other Driver'); const [confirmationStatus, setConfirmationStatus] = useState({ driver: false, other: false }); useEffect(() => { // Check if we should auto-open chat const shouldOpenChat = localStorage.getItem('openChat'); const storedDriverName = localStorage.getItem('chatDriverName'); if (shouldOpenChat === 'true') { if (storedDriverName) { setDriverName(storedDriverName); } setShowChat(true); // Clear the flags localStorage.removeItem('openChat'); // Scroll to chat section setTimeout(() => { const chatSection = document.getElementById('chat'); if (chatSection) { chatSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); } }, 100); } }, []); const handleConfirmRide = () => { setConfirmationStatus(prev => ({ ...prev, driver: true })); // Check if both confirmed setTimeout(() => { if (confirmationStatus.other) { showCommissionPopup(); } }, 500); }; const showCommissionPopup = () => { const popup = document.createElement('div'); popup.className = 'commission-popup'; popup.innerHTML = `
💰

Commission Deducted

–₹50

Amount deducted from your wallet

`; document.body.appendChild(popup); setTimeout(() => { popup.classList.add('show'); }, 100); setTimeout(() => { popup.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(() => popup.remove(), 300); }, 3000); }; return (
